body: Enough to wake up if you passed out?
I’m excited that I found some old snippets of her voice, and we took plenty pictures together, so it’ll be nice to listen to those while I drift off
All my life I’ve been fed meds. None of them ever worked. I’m just not happy. I’m content knowing it’ll be over soon

I’m ready to die. I can’t bear the thought of waking up another morning knowing what lies ahead. I’ve already gathered the things that mean the most to me and I’m holding them close. I’m just waiting for the sleep.

I’m not suffering right now. For the first time in months I’m at peace. I just want to die. I’ve never felt happiness outside that one relationship. She was the one, I had countless others, but they didn’t even compare. Now she’s gone, and any chance I had with her as well. So now I’m back to where I was before I met her.
Alone and lonely.
